title: Woodin's HOD Conjecture
exact_target: Assuming an extendible cardinal exists, must there be arbitrarily large regular cardinals at which HOD fails the specified strong measurability property?

sources.citation: Formal statement, Slide 'The HOD Conjecture' (invited talk, 12th Panhellenic Logic Symposium, 2019).
W. Hugh Woodin, Jacob Davis, and Daniel Rodríguez, The HOD Dichotomy, arXiv:1605.00613v1 (2016), Sections 1 and 3.
